statement: Cloud rental rates for the RTX PRO 6000 vary more than threefold across providers in August 2026, from $1.42 per GPU-hour on Vast.ai to $3.36 on AWS and $4.50 on Google Cloud.
why: These are quoted rental levels with no stated prior period or change, so they set a reference level without indicating direction.

impact.mechanism: A wide spread between marketplace and hyperscaler rental rates for the same card describes market segmentation, but with no baseline it carries no directional signal.

confidence.basis: Rates compiled by an interested cloud-GPU vendor's blog rather than read from each provider's own page.

dispersion: Vast.ai $1.42, AWS $3.36, Google Cloud $4.50 per GPU-hour for the same card.
